# Kaustubh Trivedi

> Software engineer in Dublin, Ireland. Builds multi-agent LLM systems and the infrastructure that keeps them running: durable state, model routing, failure recovery, and grounding checks on model output. Full stack background in Java/Spring Boot, Python/FastAPI and TypeScript/Next.js. MSc in Computer Science from TU Dublin. Open to permanent mid-level engineering roles in Dublin or remote within Ireland.

Everything below is first-party information from Kaustubh. It matches the portfolio page and the CV linked at the end. Contact by email: kaus12tri@gmail.com.

## Skills

- Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Go
- AI / LLM: multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LangChain, LLM fine-tuning (Gemma), model routing, OpenRouter, Cohere embeddings and reranking, pgvector, R2R, Azure Machine Learning
- Backend: FastAPI, Celery, Spring Boot, Node.js, REST API design, microservices, Kafka, GraphQL
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Redux, Tailwind CSS
- Databases: PostgreSQL, PostGIS, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis, CouchDB, PgBouncer
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Datadog, Caddy, self-hosted homelab
- Practices: domain-driven design, event-driven systems, monolith decomposition, systems design, Agile Scrum

## Experience

- **Data Scientist Intern (Custom LLM Scientist), Orcawise**, Dublin, Ireland (Sept 2025 – present): Built an end-to-end RAG chatbot over a 10,000+ document corpus with LangChain and a fine-tuned Gemma model, cutting a manual healthcare-sector task from hours to minutes under GDPR and HIPAA constraints. Improved answer accuracy by over 20% against baseline through fine-tuning and retrieval tuning in Python and Azure Machine Learning. Rolled the chatbot out across several business teams.
- **Full Stack Software Developer, Openspace Services**, India (Nov 2022 – June 2023): Built a real-estate management platform on Spring Boot microservices and a Next.js/TypeScript frontend, serving 5,000+ monthly active users on a 50,000+ line codebase. Made data retrieval 30% faster through PostgreSQL schema design and indexing. Set up Docker deployments with GitHub Actions CI/CD, cutting manual deployment effort by 40%. Monitored production with Datadog.
- **Software Engineering Intern, PPLWork**, remote, India (Mar 2022 – Sept 2022): Built Spring Boot REST APIs on PostgreSQL and MySQL for a payment processing framework handling 100K+ transactions a month. Improved query performance by 20% and reduced regressions by 30% with automated CI/CD and better test coverage.

Roughly two years of commercial experience across Ireland and India.

## Projects

- [Rendure](https://rendure.kaustubhsstuff.com/): Open-source multi-agent resume tailoring. Takes a resume and a job description and produces typeset RenderCV YAML. A generation agent drafts the resume, then a separate QA agent checks every claim against the source resume and rejects anything unsupported. Next.js frontend, FastAPI and Celery backend, LangChain and OpenRouter across several model providers. Self-hosted. Source: https://github.com/KaustubhTrivedi/rendure-v2
- Agent orchestration platform: Long-running multi-agent pipelines that run for weeks. Agents don't talk to each other; they coordinate through a Postgres state machine and cron scheduling, so a crashed agent resumes from durable state. Routes cheap structured-extraction stages to small models and reasoning-heavy stages to larger ones. A supervisor heartbeat escalates to a human only when needed. Every output carries typed provenance. Postgres, TypeScript, Python, OpenRouter, self-hosted.
- [Personal RAG](https://portfolio.kaustubhsstuff.com/chat): Retrieval over several years of Obsidian notes and development docs, queried from Telegram and from the portfolio's chat page. Built on R2R with pgvector and Cohere embeddings and reranking; reranking mattered more than the choice of embedding model. Runs on a homelab with Obsidian LiveSync over CouchDB, behind Caddy.
- Magpie (MSc final project, Sept – Dec 2024): Geospatial web app mapping public amenities. Led the frontend in Next.js, React and TypeScript against Go REST APIs, handling 58,000+ spatial data points with PostGIS queries and WCAG accessibility standards.
